ca1.indicator.spi.name: Schedule performance index SPI
ca1.indicator.spi.formula: earned value / planned value on the as-of day, four decimals; below 1 the contracts earn less than planned
ca1.indicator.spi.numerator: Sum of the earned value: the budget of the package share times the share of the contract accepted by the day
ca1.indicator.spi.denominator: Sum of the planned value of the baseline, cut to each contract by its share of the values of the contracts of the package
ca1.indicator.spi.nullPolicy: No index, with its reason, when a contract carries no package, its project has no baseline or the planned value is still zero; never 0
ca1.indicator.cpi.name: Cost performance index CPI
ca1.indicator.cpi.formula: earned value / actual cost on the as-of day, four decimals; below 1 the contracts cost more than the work they earned
ca1.indicator.cpi.numerator: Sum of the earned value: the budget of the package share times the share of the contract accepted by the day
ca1.indicator.cpi.denominator: Sum of the actual cost: the gross value of the payment requests certified by the day, a reversed one taking nothing
ca1.indicator.cpi.nullPolicy: No index, with its reason, when a contract carries no package, its project has no baseline or nothing was certified yet; never 0
ca1.indicator.onTimePaymentRate.name: Payment requests handled on time
ca1.indicator.onTimePaymentRate.formula: payment requests inside the payment clock / payment requests judged x 100
ca1.indicator.onTimePaymentRate.numerato: Requests whose two steps (acceptance to request, request to Treasury) are both within the days of the payment clock rule
ca1.indicator.onTimePaymentRate.denomina: Requests that have at least one step behind them
ca1.indicator.onTimePaymentRate.nullPoli: No figure when no request can be judged yet; a frozen period has none because the steps are not kept in the snapshot
ca1.indicator.measuredToAccepted.name: Accepted against measured work
ca1.indicator.measuredToAccepted.formula: accepted / measured work at the price of its line x 100
ca1.indicator.measuredToAccepted.denomin: Sum of the approved measurements at the unit price of their BOQ line
ca1.indicator.measuredToAccepted.nullPol: No figure when the denominator is zero; never 0
ca1.indicator.advanceRecoveryShortfall.n: Advance recovered more slowly than the work was accepted
ca1.indicator.advanceRecoveryShortfall.f: sum over contracts of max(0, advance x min(1, accepted / contract value) - recovered)
ca1.indicator.advanceRecoveryShortfall.n: Sum of what each contract is short of the recovery it should have made, rounded half up to the dong per contract
No figure when no row has both an advance and a contract value; zero when every advance is recovered in step with the accepted work
ca1.indicator.guaranteeExposure.name: Guarantee not in force
ca1.indicator.guaranteeExposure.formula: sum over contracts that require a guarantee of (guarantee required - guarantee in force on the as-of day)
ca1.indicator.guaranteeExposure.numerato: Guarantee the contracts require less the guarantee in force
ca1.indicator.guaranteeExposure.nullPoli: No figure when no contract requires a guarantee; zero when every guarantee required is in force
ca1.indicator.changeTierGrowth.name: Growth through changes of one tier
ca1.indicator.changeTierGrowth.formula: sum of the approved changes of the tier / original value of all the contracts selected x 100; the tiers add up to the growth through changes
ca1.indicator.changeTierGrowth.numerator: Signed sum of the approved changes of the tier asked
ca1.indicator.changeTierGrowth.denominat: Original value of all the contracts selected
ca1.indicator.changeTierGrowth.nullPolic: No figure when the denominator is zero; a tier with no approved change has none, which is not a growth of zero

ca1.indicator.claimSettlementRate.name: Claimed money granted
ca1.indicator.claimSettlementRate.formul: sum(amount granted) / sum(amount claimed) x 100, over the claims that were decided
ca1.indicator.claimSettlementRate.numera: sum(amount granted of the decided claims; a rejected claim grants nothing)
ca1.indicator.claimSettlementRate.denomi: sum(amount claimed of the decided claims)
ca1.indicator.claimSettlementRate.nullPo: No figure when the denominator is zero; a claim that is open or withdrawn is left out of both sums, and a claim that states no amount is not a claim of zero
ca1.indicator.claimLimitationRisk.name: Open claims near or past their limitation day
ca1.indicator.claimLimitationRisk.formul: open claims whose limitation day is past or within the warning days / open claims that have a limitation day x 100
ca1.indicator.claimLimitationRisk.numera: open claims whose limitation day is past, or within the near days of the rule CONTRACT_CLAIM_LIMITATION
ca1.indicator.claimLimitationRisk.denomi: open claims that have a limitation day
ca1.indicator.claimLimitationRisk.nullPo: No figure when the denominator is zero; a claim with no limitation term is not judged and its row says so
ca1.indicator.defectClosureRate.name: Defects verified and closed
ca1.indicator.defectClosureRate.formula: defects verified or closed / defects recorded x 100
ca1.indicator.defectClosureRate.numerato: non-conformances whose state is verified or closed
ca1.indicator.defectClosureRate.nullPoli: No figure when the denominator is zero
ca1.indicator.defectOverdueRate.name: Open defects past their due day
ca1.indicator.defectOverdueRate.formula: open defects past their due day / open defects x 100
ca1.indicator.defectOverdueRate.numerato: open non-conformances whose due day is before the as-of day
ca1.indicator.defectOverdueRate.nullPoli: No figure when the denominator is zero; a defect that is verified or closed is not open and is left out of both counts
ca1.indicator.defectReopenRate.name: Defects reopened after closing
ca1.indicator.defectReopenRate.formula: defects reopened at least once / defects recorded x 100
ca1.indicator.defectReopenRate.numerator: non-conformances with a reopen count above zero
ca1.indicator.defectReopenRate.nullPolic: No figure when the denominator is zero
ca1.indicator.obstacleOverdueRate.name: Open obstacles past their due day
ca1.indicator.obstacleOverdueRate.formul: open obstacles past their due day / open obstacles x 100
ca1.indicator.obstacleOverdueRate.numera: open issues linked to a contract whose due day is before the as-of day
ca1.indicator.obstacleOverdueRate.denomi: open issues linked to a contract
ca1.indicator.obstacleOverdueRate.nullPo: No figure when the denominator is zero; a closed issue is left out, and an issue of the project that names no contract is not in this report
ca1.indicator.obstacleEscalationRate.for: open obstacles escalated above the first level / open obstacles x 100
ca1.indicator.obstacleEscalationRate.num: open issues linked to a contract whose escalation level is above zero
ca1.indicator.obstacleEscalationRate.den: open issues linked to a contract
ca1.indicator.obstacleEscalationRate.nul: No figure when the denominator is zero
ca1.indicator.auditRecoveryRate.name: Audit amounts recovered
ca1.indicator.auditRecoveryRate.formula: sum(recovered) / sum(amount recommended to recover) x 100, over the financial recommendations of the findings
ca1.indicator.auditRecoveryRate.nullPoli: No figure when the denominator is zero; a finding with no financial recommendation has no figure, which is not a recovery of zero
ca1.indicator.auditOverdueRecommendation: Audit recommendations past their due day
open recommendations past their due day / open recommendations x 100
open recommendations of the findings flagged overdue
No figure when the denominator is zero; a recommendation that is closed is not open
ca1.indicator.ratingCoverage.name: Contracts with a proposed rating
ca1.indicator.ratingCoverage.formula: contracts for which a score could be proposed / contracts that can be rated x 100
ca1.indicator.ratingCoverage.numerator: contracts whose criteria with data are enough, by the rule CONTRACT_PERFORMANCE_RATING, to propose an overall score
ca1.indicator.ratingCoverage.nullPolicy: No figure when the denominator is zero; a criterion with no data has no score and is never filled with zero
ca1.indicator.ratingResponseRate.name: Contractors that answered a rating within the window
ca1.indicator.ratingResponseRate.formula: responses recorded inside the response window / ratings notified whose window is over or answered x 100
ca1.indicator.ratingResponseRate.numerat: proposals answered on or before their response day
ca1.indicator.ratingResponseRate.denomin: proposals notified that were answered, or whose response day has passed
ca1.indicator.ratingResponseRate.nullPol: No figure when the denominator is zero; a proposal whose window is still running and has no answer is not judged
ca1.indicator.contractRedShare.name: Contracts that are red
ca1.indicator.contractRedShare.formula: contracts coloured red / contracts that could be coloured x 100; the colour is the worst of the indicators that apply
ca1.indicator.contractRedShare.numerator: contracts whose worst indicator is red by the rule CONTRACT_HEALTH_RAG
ca1.indicator.contractRedShare.denominat: contracts that have at least one indicator to judge
ca1.indicator.contractRedShare.nullPolic: No figure when the denominator is zero; a contract with no indicator to judge has no colour and is not counted as green

gov11.reallocation.title: Capital reallocation by performance and its impact
gov11.reallocation.subtitle: Slow projects give, fast ones receive; the impact on the disbursement rates is simulated before approval.
gov11.reallocation.basis: Basis: snapshot of {asOf}, Treasury cutoff {cutoff}, plan of the year {year}
gov11.reallocation.donors.formula: Projects whose year-end projection is below the threshold of the plan by the rule REALLOCATION_POLICY.
gov11.reallocation.donors.title: Slow projects (can give)
gov11.reallocation.donors.caption: Projects that can give capital, slowest first
gov11.reallocation.donors.none: No project is below the threshold or has enough uncommitted capital to give.
gov11.reallocation.recipients.formula: Projects whose year-end projection is above their own plan by the rule REALLOCATION_POLICY.
gov11.reallocation.recipients.title: Fast projects (can receive)
gov11.reallocation.recipients.caption: Projects whose demand is above plan, fastest first
gov11.reallocation.recipients.none: No project has a demand above its plan.
gov11.reallocation.excluded.formula: Projects with no Treasury figure, no plan, within the normal range or below the smallest move.
gov11.reallocation.ratio.formula: The year-end projection of the project divided by its plan of the year, four decimals.
gov11.reallocation.releasable.formula: The smaller of the surplus (plan less what is kept) and the largest share of the plan; what is kept is never below what is reserved, committed and disbursed.
gov11.reallocation.demand.formula: The year-end projection less the plan of the project.
gov11.reallocation.impact.title: Impact of a proposal on the disbursement rates
gov11.reallocation.impact.error: The impact of this proposal could not be read.
gov11.reallocation.proposals.error: The list of proposals could not be read.
gov11.reallocation.impact.frozen: The record written when the proposal was handed in, at {time}: the approver reads this one.
gov11.reallocation.impact.live: Live simulation of the draft; it is recorded when the proposal is handed in.
gov11.reallocation.rate.formula: What the Treasury paid divided by the plan of the projects of the group, from the sums and never the mean of the rates; the same function as the DIS rates.
gov11.reallocation.projected.formula: Each project disburses its projection but never above its plan; a donor is capped by its smaller plan, a recipient adds the demand above its plan times the absorption of the rule.
gov11.reallocation.units.caption: Disbursement rate of each unit before and after the move
gov11.reallocation.delegation.name: Approval level by delegation
gov11.reallocation.delegation.formula: The delegation matrix of administration for the document type CAP_REALLOCATION: the role that may approve the total of the proposal.
gov11.reallocation.delegation.role: The approver must hold the role {role} or above, {levels} approval level(s).
gov11.reallocation.delegation.none: No delegation matrix is configured for reallocation: there is no limit by amount yet.
gov11.milestones.title: Forecast to the directive milestones of disbursement
gov11.milestones.subtitle: The projected cumulative at each milestone against the target, by investor, from the frozen snapshot.
gov11.milestones.snapshot: Snapshot of {asOf}, Treasury cutoff {cutoff}, plan of the year {year}
gov11.milestones.notRecorded: This snapshot has not been read for the milestones yet: that is not the same as having none.
gov11.milestones.nothingToProject: The snapshot was read but there is no unit or milestone to project.
gov11.milestones.heading: Milestone {code} on {date}, target {target}
gov11.milestones.projected.formula: What the Treasury paid up to the cutoff plus the forecast months up to the milestone (the month that holds it pro rata by days); a month without a figure gives a lower bound and is never invented.
gov11.milestones.gap.formula: The projection less the target, in points of the plan.
gov11.milestones.plan.formula: The sum of the plan of the year of the investors in scope.
gov11.milestones.caption: Projection at milestone {code} for each investor
gov11.accuracy.title: Accuracy of the disbursement forecast of each investor
gov11.accuracy.subtitle: The forecast made before each month against what the Treasury paid in it.
gov11.accuracy.truncated: There are more forecast and payment pairs than one read judges: the figures are of the part that was read.
gov11.accuracy.wape.formula: The sum of the absolute errors of the forecasts against the payments divided by the sum of the payments, over the project-months measured.
gov11.accuracy.bias.formula: Forecast less actual divided by actual; positive means the forecast was above what happened.
gov11.accuracy.months.formula: The number of different months of the project-months that had a forecast and a payment.
gov11.accuracy.caption: Forecast accuracy of {year} by investor, worst first
gov11.accuracy.band.insufficient: Too few months for a band
gov11.clocks.title: Treasury clocks: payment 2 days, advance 1 day
gov11.clocks.subtitle: From the complete dossier at the Treasury to the payment or the return, in working days.
gov11.clocks.calendarNote: Some dossiers have no due time because the year has no published working calendar: the system never guesses a day.
gov11.clocks.truncated: There are more clocks than one read judges: the figures are of the newest clocks.
gov11.clocks.open.formula: The number of dossiers sent to the Treasury not yet paid or returned.
gov11.clocks.breached.formula: The number of running clocks past their time in working days.
gov11.clocks.near.formula: The number of running clocks with no more than the warning working hours left by the rule.
gov11.clocks.inTime.formula: The dossiers paid or returned in time divided by those that ended, one decimal.
gov11.clocks.rules: Payment time {payment} working day(s), advance {advance} working day(s).
gov11.clocks.rules.name: Working days of the clock
gov11.clocks.rules.formula: Due time = when the Treasury received the complete dossier plus the working days of the rule PAYMENT_CLOCK, counted on the published working calendar.
gov11.clocks.caption: Clocks of the dossiers sent to the Treasury, newest first
gov11.clocks.returns.title: Returned dossiers by standard reason
gov11.clocks.returns.none: No dossier was returned in this period.
gov11.settlement.title: Contract settlement clocks, 5 and 4 months
gov11.settlement.subtitle: The last day for the settlement file counted from the completion of the contract by project group.
gov11.settlement.truncated: There are more clocks than one read judges: the figures are of the part that was read.
gov11.settlement.open.formula: The completed contracts whose settlement file is not yet handed in.
gov11.settlement.overdue.formula: The contracts whose settlement file is not handed in and today is after the due day.
gov11.settlement.near.formula: The contracts not yet handed in with no more than the warning days of the rule to the due day.
gov11.settlement.inTime.formula: The files handed in no later than the due day divided by those handed in, one decimal.
gov11.settlement.months: Large groups (QTQG, A, B) {large} months, small group (C) {small} months.
gov11.settlement.months.name: Settlement months by group
gov11.settlement.months.formula: Due day = the day the contract was completed plus the months of the project group by the rule CONTRACT_SETTLEMENT_DEADLINE; a day missing in the target month moves to the last day of that month.
gov11.settlement.caption: Settlement clocks of completed contracts by due day

gov11.linkage.badId: The identifier is not in the right form: enter the contract id again.

gov11.linkage.share.formula: The change of the version divided by the cost of the latest baseline of the project; without a baseline there is no share.
gov11.linkage.note: Note (required by the rule, at least 10 characters)
gov11.linkage.receipt: The review of version {id} is recorded.

gov11.lookAhead.window.formula: The weeks the plan covers, within the 2 to 6 weeks of the rule LOOK_AHEAD_POLICY, starting on a Monday.

gov12da.rule.gift.formula: Declaration day = day received + the days of the rule; a gift worth more than the review line needs a second person; a gift over the keep line is returned or handed to the unit. The flags follow the rule of the day of the declaration.
gov12da.rule.photo.formula: Two photos of two projects are the same place when they are no further apart than the metres of the rule and the same moment when they are no further apart than the minutes of the rule; the same file (SHA-256) is always named. A signal to explain, nothing more.
gov12da.rule.standing.formula: Score = overdue x the overdue weight + disputed x the disputed weight + open x the open weight + (money still owed / money step) x the money weight. A higher score comes first, to prioritise follow-up only.
gov12da.rule.transmittal.formula: Review day = day sent + the days of the rule (review or approval); a recipient may be given one extension, later, with a reason. Progress = answers in over the people who must answer.
gov12da.rule.whistle.formula: Acknowledgement day = day received + the acknowledgement days; settlement day = day received + the settlement days, as the snapshot of the rule taken when the portal was configured.

rpt.crosscheck.page.subtitle: Sets the reports of one period side by side (monthly, quarterly, steering meeting, HPM) and the frozen snapshot; a difference at the blocking level stops the release until someone other than the preparer has explained it.
rpt.crosscheck.rule.unverified: The tolerances, the blocking levels and the list of figures are starting values the business owner has not confirmed (D03); a tenant approves its own version in the governance rule screens.
rpt.crosscheck.coverage.nothing: No comparison was made: the reports are not all there, or they have no real figures. No difference does not mean the reports agree; see why comparisons were skipped below.
rpt.crosscheck.reports.title: Reports compared
rpt.crosscheck.reports.caption: Reports of the period and the frozen snapshot
rpt.crosscheck.findings.title: Differences
rpt.crosscheck.findings.none: Every comparison made agrees within the tolerance.
rpt.crosscheck.findings.noneCompared: No comparison was made, so nothing can be said to agree.
rpt.crosscheck.terms.caption: The numbers it is made of: report, source and time of each
rpt.crosscheck.path.title: Path to an explanation
rpt.crosscheck.path.regenerateReport: Generate the report {form} again from the snapshot in force, then compare again.
rpt.crosscheck.path.completeMonth: Complete the report of {period}, then compare again.
rpt.crosscheck.path.assignUnit: Give a unit to the project rows that have none: {rows}.
rpt.crosscheck.path.checkSource: Check the source figures of each number (the snapshot, the entries of the units).
rpt.crosscheck.path.explain: If the difference has a good reason, someone other than the preparer records an explanation below to allow the release.
rpt.crosscheck.explain.cannot: You cannot record this explanation: you lack the right, or you prepared a report that is part of the difference.
rpt.crosscheck.explain.problem.short: The reason needs at least 20 characters.
rpt.crosscheck.explain.problem.long: The reason has at most 2000 characters.
rpt.crosscheck.explain.problem.edges: The reason must not start or end with a blank.
rpt.crosscheck.error.self: The person who prepared a report that is part of the difference cannot explain it.
rpt.crosscheck.error.notFound: This difference is gone: the figures changed. Reload to see the differences now.
rpt.crosscheck.error.scope: You do not hold the right to explain over the whole corporation.
rpt.crosscheck.error.generic: The explanation was not recorded. Try again.
rpt.crosscheck.skipped.title: Comparisons skipped
rpt.crosscheck.skipped.caption: Comparisons without enough data, with the reason
rpt.crosscheck.gate.passed: No difference blocks the release of this draft.
rpt.crosscheck.gate.blocked: This draft cannot be issued yet: {count} blocking differences have no explanation.
rpt.common.error.crosscheckBlocked.text: Not issued: the reports of the same period do not agree and a blocking difference has no explanation by someone other than the preparer. Open the cross-report comparison to see it and explain it.
rpt.draft.crosscheck.open: See the comparison with the reports of the same period
